findings.claim: The initial collector aborted a full daily refresh when GitHub returned partial data for one renamed or deleted profile.
findings.evidence: Fixed by preserving valid aliases when data is present and covered by a partial-batch regression test.
findings.path: GitHub GraphQL response to readBatchProfiles to collectRankingDataset to refreshRankingScope

findings.claim: The initial persistence path never supplied prior entries, so rank movement was always null.
findings.evidence: Fixed by loading the latest prior-day version-compatible entries and covered by a direction-sensitive movement test.
findings.path: ranking_snapshot to persistRankingDataset to buildRankingSnapshot to RankingTable

findings.claim: An early Redis return could mask a newer Postgres snapshot.
findings.evidence: Fixed by selecting the maximum generatedAt across bundled, Redis, and Postgres snapshots; stale and malformed-cache regressions pass.
findings.path: Redis and Postgres to getRankingSnapshot to API and page

findings.claim: The original rolling timestamp windows overlapped calendar dates and made merged-PR comparisons inconsistent.
findings.evidence: The old algorithm was temporarily restored and the boundary test failed; adjacent UTC calendar windows then passed after restoration.
findings.path: createEvidenceWindows to GraphQL contributions and merged PR searches to Rising score

exemptions.claim: No explicit GitHub rate-limit sleep is needed for the current cohort.
exemptions.evidence: A complete live regeneration of 244 source profiles succeeded through the same sequential batched collector without exhausting the rate limit.

exemptions.claim: The search static-parameter change is within the production boundary.
exemptions.evidence: It preserves static generation when dependencies are healthy and prevents an existing database outage from failing the complete production build.
